name: Gorishi Queen Lure
summary: The Gorishi Queen Lure is a tool used to draw the Gorishi Hive Queen from her chamber in Un'Goro Crater. Researchers in Gadgetzan need the queen's brain to study the silithid.

sections.title: A Hive Stirred
sections.body: In the Gorishi Hive of Un'Goro Crater, a crystal is thought to attune the silithid across their hive network. The lure is used on that crystal to draw out the queen. Researchers in Gadgetzan seek her brain for study, fearing a malign intelligence may control the silithid.

faq.q: What does the Gorishi Queen Lure do?
faq.answer: The Gorishi Queen Lure is used on a crystal in the Gorishi Hive to draw out the Gorishi Hive Queen.
The lure is used on a crystal in the hatcheries of the Gorishi Hive in Un'Goro Crater.
Researchers in Gadgetzan provide the Gorishi Queen Lure so the queen can be drawn out for study.

faq.q: Why do researchers want the queen's brain?
faq.answer: The researchers need the Gorishi Hive Queen's brain to study the silithid and investigate whether a malign intelligence controls them.

faq.q: What is the crystal in the hive?
faq.answer: The crystal is believed to attune the silithid across their hive network.
